import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df_copy = df.copy()
df_copy['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_copy['order_date'])
df_copy['month'] = df_copy['order_date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
result = df_copy.groupby('month', as_index=False)['sales_amount'].sum().rename(columns={'sales_amount': 'total_sales'})
result = result.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)

fig = px.line(result, x='month', y='total_sales', title='每月销售总额趋势', markers=True)
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title='月份', yaxis_title='销售总额')
